title: Kanzul Iman
subtitle: Quran Tarjama by Alahazrat
description: The celebrated Urdu translation of the Holy Quran by Imam Ahmad Raza Khan (A'la Hazrat), presented in Roman Urdu transliteration. Regarded as one of the most eloquent and spiritually profound Urdu translations, it combines linguistic precision with deep devotional reverence, making the divine message accessible to readers worldwide.
author: Imam Ahmad Raza Khan
